blocks.content: Let's use the if statement to check if a student has passed or failed the exam. For this, we'll assume the passing grade is 50 or above.

Enter grade
90
Congratulations!
You passed the examination.
If the user enters 90, studentGrade >= 50 in the if statement will be true. In this case, the statements inside the if statements are executed.
If the user enters 35, studentGrade >= 50 in the if statement will be false. In this case, the statements inside the if statements are skipped from execution.
